import sys

def main():
    input_lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    # Parse first line for w and m
    w, m = map(int, input_lines[0].split())
    n = 0
    a = [0] * 50

    # Convert m to base w
    temp_m = m
    while temp_m > 0:
        n += 1
        a[n] = temp_m % w
        temp_m //= w

    ok = True
    i = 1
    while i <= n:
        if a[i] > 1:
            a[i] += 1
            if a[i] == w:
                while i <= n and a[i] >= w:
                    a[i] = 0
                    i += 1
                    if i > n:
                        n += 1
                        if n >= len(a):
                            a.append(0)
                    a[i] += 1
            else:
                i += 1

            if a[i - 1] > 1:
                ok = False
                break
        else:
            i += 1

    if ok:
        print("YES", end='')
    else:
        print("NO", end='')

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
